title: Seattle-based Augmodo, whose AI-powered "Smartbadges" worn by employees track shelf inventory, raised $21M led by TQ Ventures at a $350M valuation (Kurt Schlosser/GeekWire)
summary: Kurt Schlosser / GeekWire: Seattle-based Augmodo, whose AI-powered “Smartbadges” worn by employees track shelf inventory, raised $21M led by TQ Ventures at a $350M valuation — Augmodo, the Seattle startup that straps AI-powered cameras onto retail workers to track store shelves, has raised $21 million …
